## Flow 1: Real-time review triage
POST a review to the webhook → AI classifies (DE/EN) → logged to Google Sheets → Slack alert if urgent → JSON response with reply draft.

Setup: OpenAI = Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer sk-...), Google Sheets + Slack OAuth. Sheet tab must be named **Reviews**.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, review_id: $json.review_id, sentiment: $json.sentiment, category: $json.category, urgency: $json.urgency, escalated: $json.needs_escalation, reply_draft: $json.reply_draft }) }}

parameters.content:
## Flow 2: Weekly product briefing
Every Monday 08:00 → read last 7 days from the sheet → stats by sentiment, category, branch → AI writes a 150-word briefing → HTML email to the product team.
